snippet.title: Jingle Strike VR – A Holiday Laugh-Fest for All Ages | Available Now on Steam & Meta Quest
snippet.description:
Bowl, laugh, and get roasted by cheeky Christmas elves!
Jingle Strike VR brings real bowling physics, festive magical lanes, hilarious songs, and endless elf smack talk into the ultimate holiday VR experience.

🎄 Five magical lanes — including the 85-Second Slam-Down
🎅 Hilarious elves with attitude
🎶 Festive music & laugh-out-loud moments
🎳 Family-friendly fun for all ages
🏖️ NEW LANE OPENING SOON: Aussie Beach!

Play Jingle Strike VR Now:

Meta Quest Store:
https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/jingle-strike-vr/8135988243173894

Steam (PC VR):
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3941080/Jingle_Strike_VR


About the Game

Jingle Strike VR is a cozy, chaotic Christmas-themed bowling game where YOU hit strikes while the elves provide the commentary, jokes, and occasional fart. Perfect for families, casual VR players, or anyone wanting holiday fun.

Make this Christmas unforgettable — grab your headset and take your best shot!
